Memory prompt byte limits are recorded; null means the boundary was not recorded.

workflow_rules.continuation: One Load latest saved turn, exact frozen input/provider and risk acknowledgment, one Fork and submit. Check run/history reads only; no retry or API rescue. Native workspace/profile/transcript/context guards, phase2 unknown first input not pre-frozen.
workflow_rules.final_review: Restart in review-only mode, reload and Inspect saved outcome plus source/fork history. Zero coding/reversal resubmission; audit eligible baseline bytes/modes, later sentinel, immutable criteria, unchanged archives/journals. Close owned tab, stop API/listener and unload only owned model.
workflow_rules.grading: Stop/unload owned API/model. Preserve full scored workspace and independently grade with immutable criteria before later sentinel/reversal; record failures/unknown usage without repairs.
workflow_rules.phase_count: Exactly one workflow, at most two identical reserved half-budgets; no transfer, replacement, third turn, coding rescue or new model.
workflow_rules.publication: Original cohorts/no-go and G2-G5 unchanged; no causal, held-out, broad release or quality claim.
workflow_rules.restart_review: Settle owned work, stop API, unload only evaluation-owned Gemma, restart same root/settings/stores/origin; same owner reload submits nothing. Use history and saved workspace/transcript/config/context/tool progress controls.
workflow_rules.reversal: Review eligible fork then source target differences; one explicit reversal each; no no-op/equal pair. Stop on rejection/uncertainty. Inspect applied outcome and save key before Forget retained reversal; keep last key for reload, earlier-key browser lookup not claimed.

sentinel.append_utf8: Later recorded panel recovery preservation edit.

workflow_rules.source_cancel: One Send; completed non-error target write_file card AND independent target hash change; one enabled Cancel turn. No provider hold/delay. Missed trigger stays failure; fork only after cancelled source with observed target change.
workflow_rules.unknowns: Cancelled in-flight usage remains unknown; provider prefixes are reported evidence, no total compliance certification. Dispatch limit excludes cleanup/final review/transport/storage.

workspace_owner.purpose: one scheduled panel workflow, disposable git archive, never user checkout
